validation_strategy: All 390 unchanged CLEAN_val rows after every complete epoch; no holdout access
loss: Standard CE label_smoothing=.05; no additional class-weighted loss
augmentation:
Compose(
    RandomResizedCrop(size=(448, 448), scale=(0.8, 1.0), ratio=(0.9, 1.1), interpolation=bicubic, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.1)
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-10.0, 10.0], interpolation=bicubic, expand=False, fill=0)
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.85, 1.15), contrast=(0.85, 1.15), saturation=(0.9, 1.1), hue=(-0.02, 0.02))
    RandAugment(num_ops=2, magnitude=7, num_magnitude_bins=31, interpolation=InterpolationMode.NEAREST, fill=None)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), std=(0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711))
    RandomErasing(p=0.15, scale=(0.02, 0.08), ratio=(0.3, 3.3), value=0, inplace=False)
)
learning_rates: head 1e-4/3; last block 2e-5/3; earlier backbone layers decay by 0.8 per layer
controlled_change: All LR groups and cosine floor scaled by 1/3
EMA: Secondary observation, decay=min(.999,(1+successful_updates)/(10+successful_updates)); evaluated every epoch but selected only at raw-best epoch
decay_note: Weight decay applied to all parameters, matching reconstructed V1 recipe
scheduler: LinearLR start_factor .1 for 3 epochs then cosine 27, eta_min 5e-7/3
AMP: FP16, GradScaler initial 1024, overflow skip and backoff, stop after 50 overflows
checkpoint_selection_rule: Maximum RAW normal single-view validation macro mAP; save matched EMA at that epoch; never select on ensemble score
